biocs.name: Kerberos AS-REQ Enumeration
biocs.description: Detection of repeated AS-REQ requests to domain controller with user enumeration
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 88 and dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'krb5_user_enum'

abiocs.name: Kerberos AS-REQ User Enumeration Behavior
abiocs.description: Machine learning model detecting anomalous Kerberos AS-REQ patterns from unknown processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'krb5_user_enum'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != null
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 88

xql_queries.name: Kerberos Enum Network Traffic
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 88 and dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'krb5_user_enum'
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, dst_ip, dst_port
